subject: maths
question: Average of 30 observations is 58. Average of first 14 observations is 59. Average of last 17 observations is 55. What is the value of 14th observation?
solution:
**Given:**

Average of 30 observations = 58

Average of first 14 observations = 59

Average of last 17 observations = 55

**Formula Used:**

Sum = Average × Number of observations

**Calculation:**

Sum of 30 observations = 58 × 30

Sum of 30 observations = 1740

Sum of first 14 observations = 59 × 14

Sum of first 14 observations = 826

Sum of last 17 observations = 55 × 17

Sum of last 17 observations = 935

Sum of 13 observations (from 15th to 30th) = 935 - (14th observation)

Sum of 30 observations = Sum of first 13 observations + 14th observation + Sum of last 17 observations

⇒ 1740 = 826 + 14th observation + 935 - (14th observation)

⇒ 1740 = 826 + 935

⇒ 1740 = 1761

Therefore, the value of 14th observation is:

⇒ 1740 - 1761 = - 21

Sum of 13 observations (from 15th to 30th) = 935

Sum of 30 observations = Sum of first 14 observations + Sum of last 16 observations

⇒ 1740 = 826 + 935 - 14th observation

⇒ 1740 = 1761 - 14th observation

⇒ 14th observation = 1761 - 1740

⇒ 14th observation = 21

**The value of 14th observation is 21.**
